set.body: Outcome: make certified neural precision inseparable from the exact evidence table it certifies. Acceptance: introduce CertifiedNoisePrecision owning the table and certificate; HasNoisePrecision exposes that value; substitution under a reused ValueId is impossible; adversarial matrix-substitution test fails closed; crossnobis courts pass JVM and JS.
set.title: P7.1a: bind noise-precision certificates to their exact evidence
